CERP Rouen
(Compagnie d'Exploitation et de Répartition Pharmaceutiques) is a major French pharmaceutical wholesaler-distributor affiliated with the
Astera Cooperative Group
. It distributes over 32,000 health and medical products—including human and veterinary drugs, medical devices, and homecare items—sourced from hundreds of global pharmaceutical laboratories and manufacturers, rather than focusing on a few exclusive retail brands.
Kyndryl
Company Profile
Founding Year:
1919 (originally founded as
Mutuelle coopérative pharmaceutique rouennaise
or MCPR, becoming CERP Rouen in 1965).
Headquarters:
Rouen, France (39 Rue des Augustins).
What the Company Does:
Operates as a cooperative pharmaceutical wholesale distributor, providing daily secure delivery of medications, cold-chain transport, and support services to independent community pharmacies across France and international markets.
Astera
Brands and Manufacturers Distributed
CERP Rouen acts as a general B2B logistical link for community pharmacies rather than a brand-name vendor. It lists and distributes products from virtually all major authorized pharmaceutical manufacturers supplying the French and European markets, including:
Major international human pharmaceutical laboratories (e.g., prescription and over-the-counter drug makers).
Veterinary health product manufacturers.
Medical equipment, homecare, and oxygen cylinder providers (such as
Renault Tech
fitted transport for medical gas).
